# Qassab Al Kuwait — قصاب الكويت

> Mobile butcher, home slaughter, and meat delivery service operating 24/7 across all areas of Kuwait. 100% halal-certified, serving 5,000+ customers with 10+ years of experience.

## Services

- **Mobile Butcher** — A fully equipped butcher arrives at your home to perform halal slaughter, professional cutting, and hygienic packaging. Available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.
- **Home Slaughter** — Sharia-compliant slaughter performed at the customer's location by experienced butchers. Includes custom cutting, full cleanup, and sanitization of the area.
- **Slaughtered Sheep** — Fresh, healthy slaughtered sheep available daily, cut and packaged to order. Suitable for Eid Al-Adha, family gatherings, banquets, and everyday use.
- **Meat Delivery** — Refrigerated delivery of fresh meat and slaughtered sheep to all Kuwait areas. Typical arrival within 1–2 hours.

## Service Areas

All governorates and neighborhoods in Kuwait: Capital, Hawalli, Salmiya, Farwaniya, Jahra, Ahmadi, Mubarak Al-Kabeer, Sabah Al-Salem, Jaber Al-Ahmad, Al-Nuzha, Al-Qadsia, Al-Rawda, Al-Adailiya, Al-Doha, Abdullah Al-Salem, Industrial Area, Shuwaikh.

## How to Order

1. Contact via WhatsApp or phone at +965 6671 4788.
2. Share your location anywhere in Kuwait.
3. The mobile butcher arrives fully equipped within 1–2 hours.
